allow_instructions: Allow non-destructive commands that inspect, test, build, simulate, benchmark, execute notebooks, or generate GIFs and other derived artifacts inside the current workspace.
Allow commands that source .env.workshop and run project-owned Python scripts with the workspace .venv.
Allow creation or overwrite of generated benchmark, notebook output, plot, GIF, log, cache, and temporary files inside this workspace.
Allow dependency installation into the workspace-local virtual environment and non-destructive downloads or clones into the workspace.
Allow ordinary non-force Git fetch, fast-forward pull, commit, and push operations.
block_instructions: Require approval for file or directory deletion commands, recursive removal, destructive overwrite of source files, or commands targeting paths outside the current workspace.
Require approval for destructive Git operations including reset --hard, clean, force push, force checkout, rebase, amend, and history rewriting.
Require approval for sudo, system-wide package installation, service management, system configuration changes, device access, or Docker and database mutations.
Require approval for commands that send credentials, messages, or data other than ordinary Git commits to external services.
